hercules-retrieval.description: Native TF-IDF bootstrap retriever for Hercules-owned documentation. It is a real retriever but not the future neural embedding model.

documents.text: Hercules Forge owns application specifications compilation artifacts releases deployment policy builder console and prompt ingress.
Hercules Model Plane owns model identity lifecycle routing runtime binding checkpoint references and native model selection.
Hercules Training owns dataset provenance licensing jobs checkpoints evaluation suites activation gates and reproducible training evidence.
Hercules Staging Plane provides isolated deployment verification database migration recovery drills and synthetic environment testing.
Hercules Observability tracks service level objectives latency availability evidence health telemetry and operational status.
Hercules Video handles storyboard rendering campaign coordination post production quality gates and local launch workflows.
Hercules provenance controls record ownership canonical source lineage licensing commit history and artifact origin.
Hercules Agent routes intents selects tools coordinates workflows and controls agent orchestration.
Hercules Retrieval ranks documents searches memory computes relevance and returns evidence candidates.
Hercules Guard classifies action risk validates permissions protects secrets and supports policy enforcement.
Hercules Core is the target general reasoning instruction following planning explanation and transformation family.
Hercules Coder is the target software engineering debugging implementation testing review and repository work family.
